look_here_first: Creeping or floating mat of alternate glossy broad leaves, with typically 5 showy yellow petals and 10 stamens.

morphology_keys.habit: Aquatic perennial with floating or creeping stems often rooting at nodes.
morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate or fascicled; usually shiny elliptic to obovate petiolate blades.
morphology_keys.flower: Typically 5 broad yellow petals and 10 stamens; flower borne in leaf axil.
morphology_keys.fruit: Cylindrical or slightly angular capsule, usually thicker-walled; details vary across geographic subspecies.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Against L. repens/palustris, leaves alternate rather than opposite. Against erect hairy leptocarpa, peploides usually forms floating shiny-leaved mats. Subspecies need finer capsule, bracteole and petiole review.
